description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Source mapping: Page Task 8 Reuse confirmation and finish ZAQ integration cleanup.

**Files:** lib/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation.ex and relevant ZAQ API/bridge report normalization. Mattermost orchestration removal is already complete in Task 0B. Engine production code should remain unchanged unless an execution-path test proves a required contract gap.

**Work:** adapt executor receipts to the existing confirmation flow, clear delivery_plan before Engine dispatch, retain exact per-message attachment evidence, and coalesce send/edit outcomes appropriately. Preserve first-part canonical answer identity and existing replay behavior. Remove superseded duplicate ZAQ branches after both bridges migrate. Verify the dependency gate still holds; do not defer Mattermost cleanup here.

**Tests:** extend `test/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation_test.exs`, `test/zaq/engine/history/delivery_test.exs`, `test/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker_test.exs`, existing Jido/email integration suites, and `test/zaq/agent/attachment_history_integration_test.exs` for unchanged history access.

**Paths:** each confirmed group recorded once; update instead of duplicate insert; partial report; no confirmation for unknown sends; private plan bytes absent from events/inspection; provider evidence wins; bookkeeping failure never retries transport.

**Reuse:** existing DeliveryConfirmation → :record_delivery_confirmation → Engine history remains authoritative. Verify that every orchestration scenario catalogued in Task 0B is covered by ZAQ tests in Tasks 4–7; do not postpone their migration until this task. Provider contract tests remain upstream.

**Docs:** channels guide and shared ZAQ callback documentation. Verify compatibility with the Mattermost migration notes completed in Task 0B.

Preserve original Outgoing/Record contract: confirmation copy clears Record.content while retaining other existing fields as required by the current contract, and separately removes delivery_plan. Provider receipt projections must not invent source IDs/download references. Existing source-handle permission checks and Agent behavior remain unchanged.

Reuse/verification: use the existing owner and tests named above; no parallel transport pipeline, new history store, automatic Action/tool exposure or Agent-selection changes. Scope any new scheduler unit suite to genuinely distinct invariants.
title: Reuse delivery confirmation and remove duplicate ZAQ orchestration
